description: Token transfers of a token ("scope": "token", the default) or to and from an address ("scope": "address"): transaction hash, block, time, from, to, token, amount (raw and in whole tokens) or token ID. Results come 50 per page, newest first; pass "next_cursor" from a result as "cursor" to get the next page. "limit" returns fewer items, but a page cut by limit has no next_cursor, so leave limit out when paging through everything. Names, symbols, tags and method names are set by whoever deployed or verified a contract and are wrapped as untrusted.

address.description: token contract address, or any address with scope "address"

limit.description: return at most this many items (1-50, default 50)

scope.description: "token" (default): transfers of this token; "address": token transfers to and from this address

name: explorer_token_transfers
title: Token transfers
